rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — `plan_headings` is specified to "expose its yield", handing callers the span parser's positional tuple (identity, level, text, raw-text offsets, landed flag) instead of hiding it behind a smaller interface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan moves wrapper-vs-heading element resolution into `reckon/_plan_html.py` yet leaves `reckon/mcp_views.py::_authored_section_headings` re-expressing it, and §17's "one derivation of section identity" leaves the module's other `data-id` reads outside that derivation.
